messages:
Maya (CS): Quick check-in for Halo private deployment — weekly health. Noting an uptick in latency in eu-west-1 and a small cluster of KMS timeouts yesterday. TL;DR: usage +12% WoW, avg token latency +18ms in eu-west, regional uptime ~99.85%, billing trending +7%. Want to align on actions before the renewal review. Ping ops + platform. @Sam (Halo) any notes from your side?

Julian (Platform): Saw the same. Queue depth in eu-west spiked during ~02:00-03:30 UTC due to a long-running batch. Looks like the autoscaler didn't react fast enough — maybe a scale-down/scale-up race. Sharing grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/horizon/eu-west-latency

Kiran (Oncall): Checked autoscaler logs — found a scale-down race that introduced ~45s of cold starts for some pods. Fix candidate: bump min replicas to 3 for tenant halo in eu-west. Can roll a config change today.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: scale-config patch deployed to canary at 1917504328. Canary checks passed (health, readiness). Scheduled full rollout at 1917504350.

Paula (AM): Noted. @Sam — did Halo have any scheduled mass ingestion or nightly jobs that could explain the spike? Also on KMS: were the errors permission failures or network/timeout 5xxs?

Sam (Halo): We did have a nightly ingestion job that ran longer than usual last Tue. From our logs the KMS errors were mostly timeouts (502-ish), not permission denies. We added retries but still saw elevated failures in eu-west.

Maya (CS): OK plan of record: 1) Julian + Kiran to increase min replicas for eu-west (P0 config change). 2) Ops to complete full rollout and monitor. 3) Paula to propose shifting ingestion window to off-peak. 4) Eng to add improved KMS retry/backoff and run an HSM failover simulation. Also capturing this for renewal: NPS ticked +1 but repeated infra blips would raise risk. Recommend a readiness call next Tue to sync.

Julian (Platform): I'll open a PR for the autoscaler config (tagging @Kiran). PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/autoscaler/pull/342 — includes minReplica bump + a short note on scale-down cooldown.

Kiran (Oncall): Oncall will watch for 24h post-rollout. Also adding an alert tweak: fire a P1 if p95 request latency > 400ms for >10m in eu-west for tenant halo.

Sam (Halo): Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll shift ingestion to 03:30-05:30 UTC for the next week and report back if we still see KMS timeouts.

Maya (CS): :thumbsup: I'll compile a one-slide health summary for renewal and share EOD.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: full rollout completed at 1917504360 — min-replica bump applied to all eu-west nodes for tenant halo. Post-rollout 10m sample shows no KMS timeouts and latency back to baseline.

Paula (AM): Adding notes to enablement doc and scheduling readiness call. Tentative invite Tue 10:00 UTC.

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — will follow up with the slide and the invite. If any regressions ping this thread.

Kiran (Oncall): Marking monitoring window until 1917508010 (24h).
